Multica supports 31 coding tools out of the box: Amp, Antigravity, Claude Code, CodeBuddy, CodeArts, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, DevEco Code, Devin CLI, Dim, Factory Droid, Grok, Hermes, Kimi, Kiro CLI, MiniMax Code, Muse Code, Oh-My-Pi, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Pi, Qoder, Qoder CN, Qwen Code, QwenPaw, Reasonix, Trae CLI, ZeroClaw, and ZCode. The daemon auto-detects whichever CLIs you already have installed and registers a runtime for each one. Since the source code is public, you can also add your own backends. Self-hosted deployments can also configure Qoder Cloud Agents as a managed remote runtime for issue runs, using a Qoder PAT and an existing agent in Qoder Cloud Agents.
Issue dependencies that start work automatically, direct handoffs between squad members, and steering for Hermes
Send follow-up instructions to a running Hermes agent in Issues and Chat with Hermes 0.22.3 or later.

Multica는 Amp, Antigravity, Claude Code, CodeBuddy, CodeArts, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, DevEco Code, Devin CLI, Dim, Factory Droid, Grok, Hermes, Kimi, Kiro CLI, MiniMax Code, Muse Code, Oh-My-Pi, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Pi, Qoder, Qoder CN, Qwen Code, QwenPaw, Reasonix, Trae CLI, ZeroClaw, ZCode 등 31개 코딩 도구를 기본 지원합니다. 데몬이 이미 설치된 CLI를 자동으로 찾아 각각 런타임으로 등록합니다. 소스 코드가 공개되어 있으므로 직접 백엔드를 추가할 수도 있습니다. 셀프 호스팅에서는 Qoder PAT와 Qoder Cloud Agents의 기존 에이전트를 사용하여 태스크 실행용 관리형 원격 런타임으로 Qoder Cloud Agents를 설정할 수 있습니다.

Multica 开箱即用支持 31 款 AI 编程工具：Amp、Antigravity、Claude Code、CodeBuddy、CodeArts、Codex、Copilot、Cursor、DeepSeek Harness、DevEco Code、Devin CLI、Dim、Factory Droid、Grok、Hermes、Kimi、Kiro CLI、MiniMax Code、Muse Code、Oh-My-Pi、OpenClaw、OpenCode、Pi、Qoder、Qoder CN、Qwen Code、QwenPaw、Reasonix、Trae CLI、ZeroClaw、ZCode。守护进程会自动检测本机已安装的 CLI 并为每款注册一个运行时。因为源码公开，你也可以自己添加后端。自托管部署还可以使用 Qoder PAT 和 Qoder Cloud Agents 中已有的智能体，将 Qoder Cloud Agents 配置为执行任务的托管远程运行时。
Issue 依赖关系可自动开工，小队成员可直接交接，Hermes 支持追加指令
